From: Jane O'Connor <jane.oconnor@bluewave-thera.com>

Subject: Request: complete removal of test prompts/outputs and associated logs (BlueWave project BW-Alpha)

Hi Vanessa,

We ran a small internal test last week against the BW-Alpha dataset and want to remove all traces of those exchanges from your systems. Scope: all prompt/input text and generated outputs for project id BW-ALPHA-STG (staging), KV cache prefixes bw-alpha-*, model traces, and any associated request logs and audit entries from 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-09.

BlueWave needs a full deletion confirmation for compliance and internal audit. Deliverables we need:
- Confirmation of the exact objects deleted (IDs/prefixes).
- A short runbook of the steps taken.
- A cryptographic hash or checksum bundle as proof-of-execution (redacted if needed).
- Estimated completion SLA (preferably within 5 business days).

Also confirm whether deletion on staging also removes any backups or snapshots that might contain the same data. We prefer minimal disclosure (redacted proofs fine).

Thanks,
Jane O'Connor
Head of Product Operations
BlueWave Therapeutics

+1 415-555-0192

Planned SLA: target 5 business days after scope confirmation. Ops will produce a signed purge report, checksums, and a short runbook. If you prefer a live video handoff or a redacted PDF for the audit team, note that in the reply.

Marissa — can you draft the operational plan and list expected artifacts for BlueWave to approve? Rishi/Lauren — please flag any legal or security constraints we should follow for proofs (e.g., redaction levels).

Hi all,

Operational plan (draft) — scope = BW-ALPHA-STG prefixes bw-alpha-*; time window 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-09; environment = staging. Rough checklist below. Will execute once BlueWave confirms scope.

1) Snapshot identification: enumerate snapshots & backups covering the time window; mark any with BW-ALPHA-STG objects.
2) KV/prefix sweep: delete KV entries with prefix bw-alpha-* across the staging fleet; invalidate any active KV caches.
3) Model artifact purge: remove stored prompt/response artifacts from the prompt-output datastore (retention shard STG-6).
4) Request/log sweep: remove request-level logs and tracing entries for the IDs and time window; redact PII in telemetry where necessary.
5) Snapshots/backups: if BlueWave requests, we will schedule targeted snapshot scrubs; otherwise we will document their locations and propose a joint handoff to BlueWave S3 admins.
6) Verification run: run integrity checks; collect file lists and checksums.
7) Deliverables: purge_report_bluewave_20260216.zip (contains file manifest + checksums), redwood_purge_runbook_v3.pdf, sweep_script_checksums.txt.

Estimated timeline: 3–5 business days after your explicit approval. For evidence, we will provide a signed report with SHA256 checksums for generated manifests. We can redact object names (replace with obfuscated IDs) if you prefer.

Attachments referenced: redwood_purge_runbook_v3.pdf (runbook and step-by-step), sweep_script_checksums.txt (scripts and checksums used to verify deletion).

Security note from Rishi (cc'd): please confirm minimum redaction level. We will not include raw PII in any external-facing proof.

Marissa Cole
Senior Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
